dashboardAction.submittedContext: Current main fixes this and keeps AI disabled for the cheaper closed beta. /api/ai/ask returns the disabled 404 before handler import unless ARCHESTIMATOR_AI_ENABLED=true. If AI is later enabled, handleAiAskRequest now checks durable quota via checkAiAskQuota before workspace context reads or provider calls, returns 503 when quota storage is unavailable, requires a started audit upsert before DeepSeek is called, withholds successful output unless the completed audit update succeeds, and requires failed audit persistence for read-context/provider failures. Quota uses security_rate_limit_events and recordAiAskAuditEvent throws when Supabase audit storage is unavailable instead of swallowing failures. Hosted proof artifact ai-ask-quota-audit-fail-closed-2026-06-04.json records production /api/health 200 and signed-out POST /api/ai/ask returning 404 {"error":"AI is disabled for closed beta."}. Fresh verification on 2026-06-04: bunx vitest run tests/vitest/ai-ask-route.test.ts tests/vitest/ai-audit-flow.test.ts tests/vitest/ai-audit-schema.test.ts tests/vitest/ai-auth-guard.test.ts tests/vitest/ai-package-builder-route.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --reporter=dot (5 files / 66 tests). Finding was against old commit 385c08c; current main is fbd6d38.
